name: Pray
description: A 50% chance to cure one ally of its status ailments: marked, mild blind, attack down and poison.

name: Heal
description: Restores about 30 HP to an ally (30 plus or minus 10%).

name: HP Roulette
description: Spins the wheel on an ally: a 50% chance of a full heal, otherwise half of its current HP is taken away (never below 1). Teammates only.

name: Poison Spit
description: Spits venom at an enemy: a 50% chance to poison it. Poison takes 5% of its max HP at the end of each of its turns, for 3 to 5 turns.

name: Venom Removal
description: Cures poison on an ally.

name: Chance!
description: Gives a random teammate in the area a random stat up 10% for 5 turns (or until the battle ends). The stat is named on screen.

name: SP Finisher
description: Uses all remaining SP to attack an enemy. Starts at 110% of Attack and gains 5% for every 10% of the user's total SP still left.

name: Bandage Hat
description: A sloppy wrap, but it holds. Teammates only.

name: Hum a Tune
description: A calming hum that restores a little SP. Teammates only. Gives 2 SP.

name: Mend
description: A proper mend. Teammates only.

name: Soothing Mist
description: A mist that heals everyone near the aimed tile. Teammates only. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one.

name: Purify
description: Clears the poisons and curses. Teammates only. Removes every harmful status and lowered stat.

name: Lucky Lollipop
description: Heals by a candy's whim: a trickle or a gush. Teammates only. Its damage varies wildly: 40% to 200% of normal.

name: Spit Shine
description: Wipes the grime off and raises a guard. Teammates only. Removes every harmful status and lowered stat. The target guards until its next turn.

name: Greater Heal
description: A strong heal. Teammates only.

name: Rejuvenate
description: A heal that keeps on healing. Teammates only. Regen (8% hp a turn) for 4 turns.

name: Warm Blanket
description: Heals and wraps the target in comfort. Teammates only. Warded (25% less damage) for 2 turns.

name: Second Wind
description: Heals and brings back some SP. Teammates only. Gives 3 SP.

name: Chicken Soup
description: Heals, restores SP, and keeps healing a little. Teammates only. Regen (8% hp a turn) for 2 turns. Gives 2 SP.

name: Healing Circle
description: A circle of light that heals everyone in it. Teammates only. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one.

name: Restorative Rain
description: A wide rain that heals and keeps healing. Teammates only. Reaches every tile within 2 of the aimed one. Regen (8% hp a turn) for 2 turns.

name: Sanctuary
description: Cleanses the allies in the circle and wards them. Teammates only. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one. Warded (25% less damage) for 3 turns. Removes every harmful status and lowered stat.

name: Radiant Mend
description: A great mend. Teammates only.

name: Mass Renewal
description: Heals a whole line and cleanses it. Teammates only. Reaches every tile within 2 of the aimed one. Removes every harmful status and lowered stat.

name: Angel's Grace
description: Heals, cleanses, wards and renews everyone near the aim. Teammates only. Reaches every tile within 2 of the aimed one. Regen (8% hp a turn) for 3 turns. Warded (25% less damage) for 2 turns. Removes every harmful status and lowered stat.

name: Miracle
description: One ally is made whole. Teammates only. Restores 100% of max HP. Removes every harmful status and lowered stat.
